cards.name: Cha-Cha
cards.description: Move a pawn one square left. The destination must be empty.
cards.short: Slide a pawn one square left.

cards.name: Grass Knuckles
cards.description: Place a trap. A piece still there after its next turn is destroyed.
cards.short: Place a trap. Staying there is fatal.

cards.name: Pot of Greed
cards.description: Draw two cards. You may hold more than four until your turn ends; then choose discards to keep four.
cards.short: Draw two cards.

cards.name: Big Frog
cards.description: Summon a frog on your pawn starting rank. It advances one or two squares.
cards.short: Summon a frog on your pawn rank.

cards.name: Rat Hat
cards.description: Give a piece knight movement for this turn.
cards.short: Give an ally knight movement this turn.

cards.name: Unionize!
cards.description: Your pawns can advance one extra square this turn.
cards.short: Pawns advance one extra square this turn.

cards.name: Homemade Vest
cards.description: Block the next ranged attack before your next turn.
cards.flavor: Made with love. And scrap metal.
cards.short: Block one ranged hit until your next turn.

cards.name: Collector's Edition
cards.description: Gain $10 for every own turn this card has waited in your hand.
cards.short: Gain $10 per own turn held.

cards.name: LA Traffic
cards.description: End your turn immediately.
cards.short: End your turn.

cards.name: Gale Forces
cards.description: Push every piece in this file one square toward its own back rank, if open.
cards.short: Push this file toward each piece's home.

cards.name: Black Hole
cards.description: Freeze all pieces in a 3x3 area through their next turn. Friendly fire.
cards.short: Freeze a 3 x 3 area. Friendly fire.

cards.name: Time Warp
cards.description: Return a piece to its starting square, if empty.
cards.short: Return an ally to its starting square.

cards.name: Lasso
cards.description: Bind two opposing pieces within four squares of each other. Neither can move more than four squares away from the other.
cards.short: Tether two enemies within four squares.

cards.name: Skyhook
cards.description: Extract a piece. After two rounds it returns on your pawn rank.
cards.short: Extract an ally. Return in two rounds.

cards.name: Scissors
cards.description: Discard the opponent's oldest card.
cards.short: Discard the enemy's oldest card.

cards.name: Do Not Disturb
cards.description: Disable opposing items through their next turn.
cards.short: Disable enemy items for one turn.

cards.name: Blanket
cards.description: Hide the identity of your piece from your opponent until your next turn.
cards.short: Hide an ally until your next turn.

cards.name: Train Ticket
cards.description: Move a piece five squares forward into an empty square. Ends your turn.
cards.short: Move five squares forward. Ends turn.

cards.name: Scavenge
cards.description: Your piece farthest toward the enemy gets a parcel (a glow marks it). Move that same piece onto either of your two home ranks within five rounds to earn $100.
cards.short: Deliver your marked piece home for $100.

cards.name: Radio Interference
cards.description: Freeze an enemy through its next turn.
cards.short: Freeze an enemy for one turn.

cards.name: Ejector Seat
cards.description: Move a piece two squares backward into an empty square.
cards.short: Move an ally two squares backward.

items.name: Shield
items.description: Absorb one direct capture. The attack still spends the enemy turn.

items.name: Magic Shield
items.description: Absorb one spell or ranged hit. Direct captures still work.

items.name: Victoria's Secret
items.description: Receive a treasure map. Approach the buried square to reveal its X.
items.flavor: There is something in the drawer.

items.name: Castling
items.description: Swap a friendly piece with any other piece. Ends your turn.

items.name: Spider Sac
items.description: On death, your queen releases two pawns that cannot promote.

items.name: Lego Block
items.description: Stack two unmoved allies. The survivor inherits both movement patterns.

items.name: Trojan Horse
items.description: Replace an enemy pawn, bishop or rook with an enemy knight.

items.name: Flame Boots
items.description: Moving leaves a one-round trail of fire. Any piece landing there burns.

items.name: UFO
items.description: A random piece is abducted and replaced by up to four allied pawns.

items.name: Gas Bomb
items.description: Cover a 3x3 empty-of-enemies area in gas for three rounds. Enemies die on entry.
items.flavor: The Geneva Convention does not apply to chess.

items.name: Bleach
items.description: Remove a mystery, hazard or special tile.

items.name: Contractor
items.description: Temporarily grant a random upgrade path through this turn.
items.flavor: You only get what you paid for.

items.name: Heart of Speed
items.description: Move the selected piece repeatedly this turn, without capturing. End when ready.

items.name: Doomed Fate
items.description: Mark a non-royal enemy for death in five rounds.

items.name: Spirit of Wrath
items.description: This piece may make two consecutive captures in one turn.

items.name: Bottled Chaos
items.description: Transform into another one-use item at each turn start.

items.name: Glass Armor
items.description: Make a piece invulnerable until your next turn.

items.name: Thor's Lager
items.description: Lightning hits an occupied square in the chosen plus-shaped area. Friendly fire.

items.name: Pacify
items.description: For one round an enemy can move but cannot capture.

items.name: Rabid Bite
items.description: For one round an enemy may move only if it captures.

items.name: Giant Horse Conch
items.description: A knight also tramples enemies along its L-shaped path.
items.flavor: What did you think it said?

items.name: Rein Carnation
items.description: On death, reincarnate as a pawn, knight or rook based on shop spending.

items.name: Wendigo Skull
items.description: Your next capture converts its victim and sacrifices the attacker.

items.name: Double Agent
items.description: Enable friendly captures this turn. Reusable after five rounds.
items.flavor: A red spy is in the base?

items.name: Tidal Shift
items.description: Swap each surviving pawn with the unit that started behind its file.

items.name: Heatseeker Missile
items.description: Hit a non-pawn enemy within five squares of your queen.

items.name: War Flare
items.description: Mark a radius-two area. Artillery hits after the opponent has had a turn.

items.name: Scroll of Distortion
items.description: Create two linked portals. Enter either to emerge at the other if empty.

items.name: No Killing Sign
items.description: Protect a square from deaths. Kings remain vulnerable.

items.name: Toyota Hilux
items.description: Give a pawn queen movement up to five squares. It can still use guns.

items.name: Kragle
items.description: Glue a piece in place permanently. It cannot move or die.

items.name: Retreat Flag
items.description: Move a piece to its closest empty edge square. Ends your turn.

items.name: FA-18
items.description: Pay $100 to mark a row for an airstrike after one enemy turn. Eight-round cooldown.

items.name: Helicopter
items.description: Pay $70 for a delayed 3x3 airstrike. Eight-round cooldown.

items.name: Counterspawn
items.description: Destroy enemy units summoned during the last round. Cannot use on purchase turn.

items.name: Counterspell
items.description: Cancel all pending delayed attacks and enemy timed effects.

items.name: C4 Automaton
items.description: Deploy a non-attacking automaton on your back rank. It explodes on death or by ability.
items.flavor: Not originally meant to blow up.

items.name: Rocket Goat
items.description: Deploy a goat on your back rank: two-square movement, three-square rocket attack.
items.flavor: An unfortunate combination of infantry and tanks.

items.name: CIA Agent
items.description: Sacrifice one friendly soldier and gain its capture value.

items.name: Sapling
items.description: Plant a tree. In five rounds it matures and earns $15 each own turn.

items.name: Celestial Sapling
items.description: Matures after five rounds. Grants a mystical item every five own turns.
items.flavor: The blue glow is actually hidden LEDs.

items.name: Robotic Sapling
items.description: Matures after five rounds. Grants a mechanical item every five own turns.
items.flavor: We do not know how it gets bigger.

items.name: Mothership Distress Beacon
items.description: Deploy a four-square flying dropship. Its ability releases an octopus each turn.

items.name: Robotic Arm
items.description: Draw two cards instead of one when you claim a marked card tile. Still discard down to four at turn end.
items.flavor: Is this all we could use it for?

items.name: Insurance Contract
items.description: Receive $40 whenever one of your pieces dies.

items.name: Obvious Decoy
items.description: Deploy a rook-like decoy. On death it releases a knight.

items.name: Grave Robber
items.description: Gain $30 for every piece that has died in this battle.
items.flavor: The dead do not need it. Right?

items.name: The Great Heist
items.description: A 50% chance to steal up to $200, or two items if the enemy has no money.

items.name: Bottled Space Dolphin Spirit
items.description: Move or capture with a piece three times this turn.
items.flavor: Did you bring an infinite bag?

items.name: Counter-Counter-Offensive Sabotage
items.description: Your king or queen cannot die for three rounds.

items.name: Wizard
items.description: Mystical offers cost 25% less. Unlock the Chessnut Room.
items.flavor: Why do you barter with money?

items.name: Egg
items.description: Throw at an enemy to stun it, or place on an empty square to hatch a baby goose.

items.name: Horde of Wasps
items.description: Sweep a file with wasps, destroying every pawn in it.

items.name: Card Pack
items.description: Draw five cards. Keep them during your turn, then choose discards down to four at turn end.

items.name: Gun Costco Membership
items.description: Unlock the Gun Costco department. Guns equip pawns.
items.flavor: Live and die by the second amendment.

items.name: Curse of Spore
items.description: On death, leave destructible fungus on nearby empty squares.
items.flavor: At least the ending was colorful.

items.name: AliExpress Shipping
items.description: Two knights arrive on your back rank after eight rounds.
items.flavor: A patent or two may be breached.

items.name: Secret Service
items.description: Non-royal enemies cannot move next to this king or queen.

items.name: Bulldoze
items.description: Your rook may smash through one enemy and keep moving along its ray.

items.name: Logistics Sabotage
items.description: The enemy cannot use items during its next turn.

items.name: Pop-Up Pawn
items.description: After this piece next moves, a new pawn appears in front if space allows.

items.name: Pawn Cannon
items.description: Launch a pawn into your own half. It cannot attack until your next turn.

items.name: HALO Drop Commando
items.description: Deploy a protected commando outside the enemy back three ranks.

items.name: Throwing Knife
items.description: On death, kill the attacker as well.

items.name: Assassin Knife
items.description: After a capture, take one extra step forward if empty.

items.name: Second Amendment
items.description: Give every friendly pawn a random gun.

items.name: Combat Boots
items.description: Increase pawn advance range by one.
items.flavor: These boots were made for marching.

items.name: Barrett
items.description: Shoot enemies exactly two squares away. One-square movement.

items.name: Lewis Gun
items.description: Shoot adjacent enemies twice per turn.

items.name: Slingshot and Grenade
items.description: Shoot an adjacent enemy without moving.

items.name: Glock 17
items.description: Two-square movement and an adjacent ranged attack.

items.name: M4
items.description: Two-square movement and a ranged attack within two surrounding squares.

items.name: Pot of Gold
items.description: Claim $300. Appears after meeting the Leprechaun.
